classification.difficultyReason: Complete supplied right-angle and straight-line equations, including three-sector totals.

content.prompt: Find the value of each pronumeral.

spec.description: Vertical and rightward outer arms, diagonal interior ray, small right-angle square; no arcs or dots.
spec.mathematics: The vertical-to-diagonal sector is 52 degrees; the diagonal-to-horizontal sector is x. Outer arms are perpendicular. Source slopes are schematic.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens and x only; supplied 38 degrees belongs to the answer.

answer.worked:
Angles in a right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}x+52&=90\\x&=38\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Rightward and downward perpendicular arms, shallow down-right interior ray and square; no arcs or dots.
spec.mathematics: 13 degrees is between the rightward arm and interior ray; x fills the remaining right-angle sector. Source is schematic.
spec.answerVisibility: 13 degrees and x visible; 77 degrees is answer evidence.

answer.worked:
Angles in a right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}x+13&=90\\x&=77\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Four rays from a lower-left vertex; perpendicular vertical and horizontal outer arms with square. Two interior rays.
spec.mathematics: From vertical to horizontal the sectors are 25 degrees, x, 12 degrees. No arcs or dots.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 25 degrees, x and 12 degrees on question diagram.

answer.worked:
Angles in a right angle add to $90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}x+25+12&=90\\x+37&=90\\x&=53\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal straight line and steep up-right ray; no arcs or dots.
spec.mathematics: Upper-left sector x and upper-right sector 60 degrees form a straight angle.
spec.answerVisibility: x and 60 degrees visible; 120 degrees withheld from prompt.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line add to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}x+60&=180\\x&=120\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upper-left to lower-right diagonal straight line, with almost horizontal leftward third arm; no arcs or dots.
spec.mathematics: 28 degrees labels the upper-left small sector; x labels the adjacent lower sector. Stated values take precedence over schematic slopes.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line add to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}x+28&=180\\x&=152\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Slightly descending straight line through a vertex, with down-left and down-right rays. No arcs or dots.
spec.mathematics: Lower sectors from the left line arm to the right line arm are x, 48 degrees, 62 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: x, 48 degrees and 62 degrees visible; answer separate.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line add to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}x+48+62&=180\\x+110&=180\\x&=70\end{align*}$$
